useful_existing_contract.claim: Its already written outer negation and negative branch can express a useful class-wide factual assertion without adding a universal marker or enlarging its learned vocabulary. This is a logical consequence of the existing source-side grammar, not a new historical mechanism or successful native carrier.
useful_existing_contract.plain_author_intent: Factual assertion: Every vessel contains some water. Equivalently, there is no vessel without water. This is not the command to fill vessels.
useful_existing_contract.complete_existing_teaching_spelling: rr tf nn pk fm ii oo
hand_steps: rr opens denial of the entire existential description.
tf constrains the current starting entity x to be a vessel and does not move away from x.
nn saves x and negates the subordinate path starting from that same x.
pk goes from x to a contained entity y; fm constrains y to be water.
ii closes that negative branch and restores x; oo closes the outer denied existential description.
useful_existing_contract.formula: NOT EXISTS x [ VESSEL(x) AND NOT EXISTS y (CONTAINS(x,y) AND WATER(y)) ]
useful_existing_contract.equivalent_formula: FOR ALL x [ VESSEL(x) IMPLIES EXISTS y (CONTAINS(x,y) AND WATER(y)) ]
useful_existing_contract.why_legal_without_repair: The existing grammar already permits rr PATH oo and an nn PATH ii item, with both negation scopes explicitly defined. tf,pk,fm are already learned entries. There is no new quantifier token, silent participant, branch binding, relation definition or source annotation.
